The empty branch uses first = sentinel to force the owned xizi_dllseg sequence to nil, giving first_value nil = 0 while preserving the segment. The nonempty branch uses first <> sentinel to rule out nil, expose first as the abstract sequence head, and reclose the unchanged sentinel links plus segment as xizi_dll. No annotation/spec repair or group-local case_lib helper is needed.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Case-analyze the abstract nodes encoded by xizi_dllseg and compare its start pointer with the sentinel stop pointer.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Preserve the segment in the empty case; combine sentinel stores with the same segment and apply xizi_dll_close in the nonempty case.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: first = sentinel eliminates the cons case and yields first_value nil = 0; first <> sentinel eliminates nil and yields first_value nodes = first.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: Both witnesses are complementary branches of one straight-line sentinel-head observation and use the same predicate unfolding. The group has 2 witnesses, below the controller limit of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For return_wit_1, select the segment-preservation disjunct, destruct nodes, rule out cons using first = sentinel against the nonempty dllseg guard, reduce first_value nil to 0, and cancel the unchanged segment. For return_wit_2, select the full-DLL disjunct, rule out nil using first <> sentinel, obtain that first is the abstract head from the nonempty dllseg branch, prove the first_value equality, combine the sentinel fields as xizi_dll_links, and apply xizi_dll_close. No case_lib helper is needed.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The circular sentinel implementation is abstracted by one predicate fact: an equal segment start/stop represents the empty sequence, while a distinct start/stop forces a nonempty sequence whose head is the start pointer. Use that fact directly, then preserve or close the ownership without mirroring the C conditional.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, complementary sides of the same sentinel/segment case analysis, same case_lib observation, no dependencies, and only two witnesses within max_witnesses_per_group = 12.
